# Announcer voice clips

`good_shot.wav`, `nice_shot.wav`, `three_points.wav` and `thanks.wav` were generated locally on 2026-10-29 with Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0, https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M),
voice `af_heart`, 24 kHz mono, trimmed and peak-normalised. No text or audio left the machine and no third-party recording is included.
